digest.component_or_area: Plan review LLM prompting and caching
propositions: Anthropic cache breakpoint applies only to byte-identical system blocks, so Pass-2 verifier with plan in user message gains no cache benefit from Pass-1
Plan placed in verifier system prompt as a shared-prefix enables within-pass reuse across chunks and cross-run reuse within Anthropic's ephemeral cache TTL

Byte-identical plan-bearing prefix must be enforced as a single-sourced structural invariant across Pass-1 finder and both verifier prompts to prevent drift and position for provider-side prefix reuse
Pass-1 finder warm gate must measure actual cached prefix (preamble + plan) not plan alone to correctly assess whether threshold CACHE_MIN_PREFIX_TOKENS is met
Incremental-depth BLOCK loops require exhaustiveness directive in shared reviewing stance to ensure all findings are surfaced in each review round
Finding listing must remain in user turn (base_instructions → instructions) and absent from system segment after moving plan to shared prefix
